notes.zh: 措施自 2026-12-04（美东 00:01）起生效，此前不产生关税；进口商须提交不低于 MIP 的售价证明，否则按 MIP 差额补征特定关税。日/韩/中国台湾/瑞士/列支敦士登/欧盟产品：第 1 栏税率与本项合计不超过 15%；英国为 10%。快照尚未编入对应的 Chapter 99 税号 —— 与「以公告形式实施的措施不进 HTS 税率字段」一致。
notes.en: The measures take effect at 00:01 ET on Dec 4, 2026 and impose no duty before then; importers must document a price at or above the MIP, failing which a specific duty equal to the shortfall applies. For products of Japan/Korea/Taiwan, China/Switzerland/Liechtenstein/the EU, the Column 1 rate plus this measure may not exceed 15%; the UK is 10%. No corresponding Chapter 99 heading appears in the snapshot — consistent with proclamation-based measures never entering HTS rate fields.
